destination.name: Xuzhou
destination.tagline: Han royal tombs and terracotta warriors in a lake city on the Beijing-Shanghai line.
destination.description: Xuzhou was the seat of the Chu kings of the Western Han, and their tombs are its main draw. Lion Hill holds a Chu king's tomb and a museum of Han terracotta warriors, while Guishan has a rock-cut tomb palace. In the city, Yunlong Mountain and Yunlong Lake offer walks and views, and Hubu Hill keeps Ming and Qing courtyard houses. It is a major rail hub, roughly halfway between Beijing and Shanghai.
whyVisit: Stroll the shore of Yunlong Lake

goodToKnow.title: Don't book Suzhou by mistake
goodToKnow.detail: Travellers often buy tickets to Suzhou by accident. Show the characters 徐州 and use Xuzhou East for high-speed trains.

goodToKnow.title: Combined tickets
goodToKnow.detail: ¥90 covers every attraction in the Han Culture Scenic Area at Lion Hill, and ¥80 covers all of the Guishan Scenic Area.

goodToKnow.title: Several sights are free
goodToKnow.detail: Xuzhou Museum, the Huaihai Campaign museum and Yunlong Lake are free. Yunlong Mountain is free too, but Xinghua Temple charges ¥4.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: Mild days in {months} suit climbing hills and walking the lake, before the summer heat.
